name: acesio-dashboard
description: Dashboard pencatatan layanan & komisi Acesio (user + admin), siap integrasi WA bot

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const files=['server','scripts','public','test'].flatMap(d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{recursive:true}).map(f=>d+'/'+f):[]).filter(f=>/\.m?js$/.test(f)&&!f.includes('node_modules'));let bad=0;for(const f of files){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0){bad++;console.error(r.stderr)}}console.log(files.length+' berkas diperiksa, '+bad+' gagal');process.exit(bad?1:0)"
